court_record.dd: 3/10 PASS (conservative direction, no escalation needed): (1) THE DISCOUNT IS GONE — 60%+ (2022-23) -> 16.2% (Mar-31) -> ~5% now after +330% in two years; the margin of safety that made the country binary ownable was paid to 2023-24 buyers; (2) THE MANDATE BREACH — 47.2% of NAV is Lion Finance Group = the ex-BANK OF GEORGIA (renamed Feb-2025, still BGEO), one of the two excluded names; the entire FY25 re-rate was that stake (+97.5%); at 44.80 the implied price of the NON-bank private book is ~10% below its Kroll mark — the only 'value' left, and it's management-marked (53% of NAV, no listed reference since GHG went private 2020); (3) quality is NOT the problem: net cash, debt-to-zero guided 2026, 33.9% of shares retired since 2018 (buyback-only = no taxable income event), internally managed, water sale to Aqualia DONE ($180M received, residual 20% put exercisable 2025/26 = the one market-tested forward reference); Gilauri chair+CEO = the flag; (4) BOND DOMINANCE INVERTED vs TBC: at ~NAV the GGU 8.875% 2029 USD bond (senior, defined maturity, same country factor) dominates the equity for a carry buyer — the opposite of the TBC finding where cheap equity cleared the floor; (5) liquidity fine ($3.3M/day ADV).
court_record.analyst_claim_adjudication: 'Political climate is calm' = REFUTED as a country-risk statement, defensible ONLY as macro: GDP 7.5-8.4%, GEL flat, reserves ATH $7.0bn, inflation 3.9% (the analyst's real datum, and it's genuinely strong). Against it: 500+ consecutive protest days thinned by FATIGUE with the crackdown intensifying, EU accession frozen to 2028 + official visa-free SUSPENDED Mar-6-2026 + full-population suspension threatened, Ivanishvili OFAC-sanctioned Dec-2024 w/ a live secondary-sanctions channel, 7+ opposition leaders jailed, no pressure valve until 2028. The lagging-indicator trap: a quiet street + strong macro generalized into 'risk resolved' — they are OPPOSITE things here. CORROBORATES our ~20% TBC tail; the one genuinely calmer vector is the US axis (MEGOBARI shelved Dec-2025).
court_record.adjudication: accepted at the presiding desk; the alpha was the EXCLUSION of the stale premise

edge_explainer.market_believes: (Now) Georgia Capital is a well-run compounder worth ~its asset value — after two years of believing it was worth half that.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The market is right now and was wrong then — which means the trade is over. What's left is full price for an unhedgeable ~20% country tail, with half the assets being a bank we're mandated not to own.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The edge was negative: grading a local analyst's 'calm' against the EU/sanctions record, and reading the NAV's fine print (47% excluded bank; 53% management-marked).
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: A re-widening past 20% on an insulated shock re-arms the original trade; the band watcher holds the tripwire at ~£38.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: A durable move to a NAV premium with the private book transaction-validated (Aqualia put strike confirming Kroll) would say the compounder deserves full price and the re-entry never comes.
edge_explainer.edge_type: the pass is the position; GGU 8.875% 2029 flagged as the dominant instrument IF Georgia carry is ever wanted
